title: eria tomentosa
intro: Eria tomentosa, commonly known as the "Sacred Champa" or "Champak", is a flowering plant native to the tropical forests of Asia. This plant is valued for its fragrance and medicinal properties, with the flowers being used in traditional Indian medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Eria tomentosa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, relaxation, and pain relief.
